normalization.description: Benchmark total wall time divided by median wall time of a deterministic 3,000,000-iteration Python integer-mix calibration on the same interpreter/environment.

policy.rationale: The normalized ratio limits CPU-relative runtime without binding release acceptance to one host's clock speed. The 256 MiB RSS ceiling provides >2x headroom over the P7 10k/50k baseline while still catching gross scalability regressions. Exact workload/correctness counts prevent a faster run from passing by doing less work.
